legal_source.name: EC Migration & Home Affairs — Schengen area (membership); Council Decisions (EU) 2022/2451 and 2024/210 (accessions); EC short-stay calculator manual §1 (day-counting exclusions)

_notes: Verified per Accuracy Policy §3 (source verification, no human review — owner decision 2026-07-13): every value below traces to the primary official sources in _sources.

schengenSince = the date the state began fully applying the Schengen acquis (visas, day counting) — for BG/RO that is 2024-03-31 per Council Decision (EU) 2024/210, NOT the 2025-01-01 land-border date.

_sources.claim: 29 Schengen members: 25 EU + IS/NO/CH/LI; Cyprus integration underway; Ireland opt-out
_sources.name: EC Migration & Home Affairs — Schengen area

_sources.claim: Croatia: full application of the Schengen acquis from 2023-01-01
_sources.name: Council Decision (EU) 2022/2451

_sources.claim: Bulgaria & Romania: full application of the Schengen acquis from 2024-03-31 (air/sea internal checks lifted)
_sources.name: Council Decision (EU) 2024/210; Council press release 2023-12-30

_sources.claim: Bulgaria & Romania: internal land border checks lifted 2025-01-01 (full membership; no effect on day counting)
_sources.name: EC Migration & Home Affairs news, 2025-01-03

_sources.claim: Stays in Cyprus, Ireland and the UK do not count toward 90/180; stays in IS/LI/NO/CH do
_sources.name: EC short-stay calculator user manual, §1

_sources.claim: ETIAS covers 30 participating European countries (29 Schengen + Cyprus), hence etiasRequired=true for CY
_sources.name: EEAS — Coming visa-free to Europe (official EU)

countries.name: Bulgaria
countries.notes: Full Schengen acquis applied from 31 Mar 2024 (Council Decision (EU) 2024/210); land border checks lifted 1 Jan 2025. Stays before 31 Mar 2024 do not count toward Schengen 90/180.

countries.name: Croatia
countries.notes: Full Schengen acquis applied from 1 Jan 2023 (Council Decision (EU) 2022/2451). Stays before that date do not count toward Schengen 90/180.

countries.name: Iceland
countries.notes: Non-EU Schengen member — short stays count toward 90/180 (EC manual §1).

countries.name: Liechtenstein
countries.notes: Non-EU Schengen member — short stays count toward 90/180 (EC manual §1).

countries.name: Norway
countries.notes: Non-EU Schengen member — short stays count toward 90/180 (EC manual §1).

countries.name: Romania
countries.notes: Full Schengen acquis applied from 31 Mar 2024 (Council Decision (EU) 2024/210); land border checks lifted 1 Jan 2025. Stays before 31 Mar 2024 do not count toward Schengen 90/180.

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.notes: Non-EU Schengen member — short stays count toward 90/180 (EC manual §1).

countries.name: Cyprus
countries.notes: EU member, not yet applying Schengen in full ('integration underway' per EC, checked 2026-07-13) — stays do NOT count toward 90/180 (EC manual §1). ETIAS DOES apply: the only non-Schengen country among the 30 ETIAS countries (EEAS).

countries.name: Ireland
countries.notes: EU member, opt-out from Schengen — stays do NOT count toward 90/180 (EC manual §1).

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.notes: Stays do not count toward 90/180 (EC manual §1). UK runs its own 180-day visitor rule — Phase 2 multi-jurisdiction ledger.
